subject: general
question: In a row of students all facing north, Aniket is 12th from the left and Kavlin is 18th from the right. If their positions are swapped, Kavlin becomes 14th from the right. What is the total number of students in the row?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• All are facing North. 
 
• Aniket is 12th from the left.
 
• Kavlin is 18
